routes.label: fast track through the High Commission in London
a valid passport lost or damaged, through the High Commission in London

note: From 1 July 2024 a passport issued by the Immigration Department costs $350 and is valid ten years, five years under 18 (NOW Grenada's report of the amendment to the Passports Act, Chapter 226, passed on 25 June 2024); the minor's fee at home is not stated, so it is left unpaid. The High Commission in London charges in pounds from the same date (£277.00 for ten years from 18, £195.00 for five years to 17, each with a £25.00 processing fee, in 6 weeks; fast track £428.00 and £346.00 in 2 to 4 weeks), the abroad routes' currency: GBP 302.00 and 220.00 with the processing fee in 6 weeks, the fast track as listed in 4 weeks at the longest, and a valid passport lost or damaged GBP 553.00 plus the processing fee (578.00; an expired one lost costs the ordinary fee), written for an adult, the schedule giving no minor's figure.

sources.title: NOW Grenada, Passports to cost EC$350 and valid for 10 years (25 June 2024)
sources.said: From 1 July 2024, the price of a passport approved and issued by the Immigration Department will increase to $350. It will be valid for 10 years except when the holder is under the age of 18 years.

sources.title: High Commission for Grenada, London, Grenadian Passport & Visa Fees (with effect from 1 July 2024)
sources.said: Passport Application (renewal and First Time) (6 Weeks): ❖ £195.00 (36 pages – 5 yr) (From birth to 17 years) ❖ £25.00 – PROCESSING FEE ❖ £277.00 (36 pages – 10 yr) (18 years and above) ... Fast Track (2 - 4 weeks) ❖ £346.00 (36 pages – 5 yr) (From birth to 17 years) ❖ £428.00 (36 pages – 10 yr) (18 years and above) Lost, Damaged, Early Application: ❖ £553.00 (if the passport has not expired) ❖ £277.00 (if the passport is expired) ❖ £25.00 – PROCESSING FEE An additional fee of £126.00 is charged for Fast track of lost, damaged and early renewal of passport
